notes: hayetah le-'ish is read under rule 43: hayah takes hath had and the lamed is unrepresented; the alternative of giving the have to the preposition is excluded because hayah is written.
The article on ha-betulah is unrepresented under rule 29, the ASV writing a virgin: an indefinite a is the noun's under rule 15 and is not a determiner written in the article's place under rule 41.
